ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Outlook Form
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a new Outlook form which can contain malicious code

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\FORMS\\\\IPM.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Local\\ Settings\\\\Application\\ Data\\\\Microsoft\\\\Forms.*")))
